description: Unskinned assets: ships, buildings, island pieces, modular kits, props. Customised by swapping parts on sockets and by dye masks.
units: metres; glTF +Y up, +Z front (bow of a ship points +Z)
origin: base centre on the ground plane (ships: waterline at hull centre)
sockets: empties named Socket_<Name> anywhere in the hierarchy; held props carry one empty named Grip at the hand-hold, Y along the handle

ship.note: Sails may carry a small bone chain or shape keys for billowing; that is the only skinning on a ship.

kit.note: modular pieces snap on a 0.5 m grid, pivots on grid corners

procedural: generators live in scripts/forge/procgen/<kind>.py: deterministic Blender Python taking a JSON spec and a seed

material.style: painterly albedo or vertex colours, toon ramp
